q: What is the capital of Nigeria?
exp: Abuja became Nigeria's capital in 1991, replacing Lagos.
ai_exp:
Nigerian Capital Analysis:

• Lagos: Former capital (until 1991) ✗
• Abuja: Current capital (since 1991) ✓
• Kano: Major northern city ✗
• Ibadan: Major southwestern city ✗

Historical context:
• 1914: Lagos was capital
• 1991: Capital moved to Abuja
• Abuja was purpose-built as the capital

Option A: Former capital ✗
Option B: Current capital ✓ Correct!
Option C: State capital, not national ✗
Option D: State capital, not national ✗

The correct answer is B) Abuja.

q: Which is the longest river in Nigeria?
exp: River Niger is the longest river in Nigeria, flowing about 4,180 km total.
ai_exp:
Nigerian Rivers Analysis:

• River Benue: Major tributary, about 1,400 km ✗
• River Niger: Longest, about 4,180 km total ✓
• River Kaduna: Tributary, shorter ✗
• River Ogun: Short river in southwest ✗

River Niger:
• Originates in Guinea
• Flows through Nigeria
• Empties into Atlantic Ocean

Option A: Tributary of Niger ✗
Option B: Longest river ✓ Correct!
Option C: Tributary ✗
Option D: Minor river ✗

The correct answer is B) River Niger.

q: The tropical rainforest is characterized by:
exp: Tropical rainforests have dense, multi-layered vegetation due to high rainfall and temperature.
ai_exp:
Vegetation Analysis:

• Sparse vegetation: Characteristics of deserts ✗
• Dense multi-layered vegetation: Rainforest feature ✓
• Cacti and shrubs: Desert vegetation ✗
• Only grasses: Savanna grassland ✗

Rainforest features:
• High rainfall (200+ cm annually)
• High temperature
• Multiple canopy layers
• Dense vegetation

Option A: Desert ✗
Option B: Rainforest ✓ Correct!
Option C: Desert ✗
Option D: Grassland ✗

The correct answer is B) Dense multi-layered vegetation.

q: Which of the following is a renewable natural resource?
exp: Solar energy is renewable because it comes from the sun and cannot be exhausted.
ai_exp:
Resource Analysis:

Renewable resources:
• Solar, wind, water, biomass
• Replenish naturally

Non-renewable resources:
• Coal, petroleum, natural gas
• Take millions of years to form
• Will eventually run out

Option A (Coal): Non-renewable (fossil fuel) ✗
Option B (Petroleum): Non-renewable ✗
Option C (Solar): Renewable ✓ Correct!
Option D (Natural gas): Non-renewable ✗

The correct answer is C) Solar energy.

q: The highest mountain in Africa is:
exp: Mount Kilimanjaro (5,895 m) in Tanzania is Africa's highest mountain.
ai_exp:
African Mountains Analysis:

• Mount Kenya: 5,199 m - second in Africa ✗
• Mount Kilimanjaro: 5,895 m - HIGHEST in Africa ✓
• Mount Everest: 8,849 m - in Asia ✗
• Mount Cameroon: 4,040 m ✗

Mount Kilimanjaro:
• Located in Tanzania
• Dormant volcano
• Height: 5,895 meters

Option A: Second highest ✗
Option B: Highest ✓ Correct!
Option C: In Asia ✗
Option D: Much shorter ✗

The correct answer is B) Mount Kilimanjaro.

q: The layer of the atmosphere closest to Earth's surface is:
exp: The troposphere is the lowest layer, where weather occurs.
ai_exp:
Atmospheric Layers (bottom to top):

1. Troposphere - CLOSEST to Earth ✓
2. Stratosphere - Contains ozone layer
3. Mesosphere - Meteors burn up
4. Thermosphere - Aurora occurs

Troposphere:
• 0-12 km altitude
• Contains 75% of atmosphere
• Where WEATHER occurs

Option A: Second layer ✗
Option B: First/closest layer ✓ Correct!
Option C: Third layer ✗
Option D: Fourth layer ✗

The correct answer is B) Troposphere.

q: Which of these is NOT a type of rock?
exp: Volcanic glass (obsidian) is a type of igneous rock, not a rock category.
ai_exp:
Rock Classification:

Three main rock types:
1. Igneous - From cooled magma ✓
2. Sedimentary - From compressed sediments ✓
3. Metamorphic - Changed by heat/pressure ✓

Volcanic glass (obsidian):
• This is a TYPE of igneous rock
• Not a separate rock category

Option A: Main rock type ✗
Option B: Main rock type ✗
Option C: Main rock type ✗
Option D: Type of igneous rock, NOT a category ✓ Correct!

The correct answer is D) Volcanic glass.

q: The largest ocean in the world is:
exp: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.
ai_exp:
Ocean Size Analysis (largest to smallest):

1. Pacific - 165 million km² ✓ LARGEST
2. Atlantic - 106 million km²
3. Indian - 70 million km²
4. Arctic - 14 million km²

Pacific Ocean:
• Covers about 30% of Earth's surface
• Deepest point: Mariana Trench

Option A: Second largest ✗
Option B: Third largest ✗
Option C: Largest ✓ Correct!
Option D: Smallest ✗

The correct answer is C) Pacific Ocean.

q: The imaginary line that divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres is:
exp: The Equator divides Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres.
ai_exp:
Geographic Lines Analysis:

• Prime Meridian: Divides East/West hemispheres ✗
• Equator: Divides NORTH/SOUTH hemispheres ✓
• Tropic of Cancer: 23.5°N latitude ✗
• Arctic Circle: 66.5°N latitude ✗

Equator:
• 0° latitude
• Divides Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres

Option A: East/West division ✗
Option B: North/South division ✓ Correct!
Option C: Northern latitude line ✗
Option D: Northern latitude line ✗

The correct answer is B) Equator.

q: Which country is Nigeria's western neighbor?
exp: Benin Republic borders Nigeria to the west.
ai_exp:
Nigeria's Borders:

• West: Benin Republic ✓
• East: Cameroon ✗
• North: Niger ✗
• Northeast: Chad ✗

Option A (Cameroon): Eastern border ✗
Option B (Chad): Northeastern border ✗
Option C (Benin): Western border ✓ Correct!
Option D (Niger): Northern border ✗

The correct answer is C) Benin Republic.
